hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook collecting a 0.7% fee on every swap: ETH from buys accumulates in a burn pot for buyback-and-burn every 20 swaps, and token input from sells is burned directly. Liquidity addition is one-time per token, and sells are blocked in the same block as a buyback. Additionally, any address can activate a per-token sell allowlist by calling registerPixel, restricting sells to addresses the deployer pre-approves via preparePixels; only the deployer (genesisAddress) can deactivate it.
